script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT(
  'ia', (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(h.id AS CHAR), 'status', h.item_assembly_status, 'hold', h.material_hold_status,
                 'plant', CAST(h.issuing_operation_faci AS CHAR), 'org', h.organization_id, 'no', h.stock_movement_no, 'item_id', CAST(h.item_id AS CHAR),
                 'item_qty', h.item_qty, 'planned_output_qty', h.planned_output_qty, 'bom_consumption_mode', h.bom_consumption_mode,
                 'source_bom_id', CAST(h.source_bom_id AS CHAR))
           FROM sm_item_assembly h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_TRguard.data.ia}} AND h.is_deleted = 0),
  'lines', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(a.id AS CHAR), 'item_selection', a.item_selection, 'item_name', a.item_name,
                   'quantity_uom', CAST(a.quantity_uom AS CHAR), 'requested_qty', a.requested_qty, 'required_qty', a.required_qty, 'sc_ref_key', a.sc_ref_key,
                   'line_index', a.line_index, 'temp_qty_data', a.temp_qty_data, 'temp_hu_data', a.temp_hu_data))
              FROM sm_item_assembly_tlm8ve69_sub a WHERE '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.needLines}}' = 'YES' AND a.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND a.sm_item_assembly_id = {{node:code_node_TRguard.data.ia}} AND a.is_deleted = 0),
  'holds', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(r.id AS CHAR), 'status', r.status, 'doc_line_id', r.doc_line_id, 'material_id', CAST(r.material_id AS CHAR),
                   'bin_location', CAST(r.bin_location AS CHAR), 'batch_id', CAST(r.batch_id AS CHAR), 'from_category', r.from_category,
                   'open_qty', CAST(r.open_qty AS CHAR), 'reserved_qty', CAST(r.reserved_qty AS CHAR), 'item_uom', CAST(r.item_uom AS CHAR), 'job_line_key', r.job_line_key))
              FROM on_reserved_gd r WHERE '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.needLines}}' = 'YES' AND r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND r.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.org}}' AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.doc_type = 'Item Assembly' AND r.doc_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.ia}}' AND r.status = 'Allocated'),
  'uomNames', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(u.id AS CHAR), 'uom_name', u.uom_name))
                 FROM unit_of_measurement u WHERE '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.needDefect}}' = 'YES' AND u.id IN (SELECT a3.quantity_uom FROM sm_item_assembly_tlm8ve69_sub a3
                                                                                      WHERE a3.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND a3.sm_item_assembly_id = {{node:code_node_TRguard.data.ia}} AND a3.is_deleted = 0)),
  'binNames', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(b.id AS CHAR), 'name', b.bin_location_combine))
                 FROM bin_location b WHERE '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.needDefect}}' = 'YES' AND b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND b.id IN (SELECT r.bin_location FROM on_reserved_gd r WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND r.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.org}}' AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.doc_type = 'Item Assembly' AND r.doc_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.ia}}' AND r.status = 'Allocated')),
  'batchNos', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(c.id AS CHAR), 'batch_number', c.batch_number))
                 FROM batch c WHERE '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.needDefect}}' = 'YES' AND c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND c.id IN (SELECT r.batch_id FROM on_reserved_gd r WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND r.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.org}}' AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.doc_type = 'Item Assembly' AND r.doc_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.ia}}' AND r.status = 'Allocated')),
  'items', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(i.id AS CHAR), 'stock_control', i.stock_control, 'serial_number_management', i.serial_number_management,
                   'material_name', i.material_name, 'material_code', i.material_code, 'material_desc', i.material_desc))
              FROM item i WHERE '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.needLines}}' = 'YES' AND i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND i.is_deleted = 0 AND i.id IN (SELECT CAST(a2.item_selection AS UNSIGNED) FROM sm_item_assembly_tlm8ve69_sub a2
                       WHERE a2.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND a2.sm_item_assembly_id = {{node:code_node_TRguard.data.ia}} AND a2.is_deleted = 0)),
  'uoms', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('item', x.item, 'row', x.row_j))
             FROM (SELECT CAST(c.Item_id AS CHAR) AS item,
                          JSON_OBJECT('create_dept', CAST(u.create_dept AS CHAR), 'create_time', LEFT(DATE_FORMAT(u.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), 23), 'create_user',
		CAST(u.create_user AS CHAR),
                            'id', CAST(u.id AS CHAR), 'is_deleted', u.is_deleted, 'organization_id', u.organization_id, 'sub_tenant_id', CAST(u.sub_tenant_id AS CHAR),
                            'tenant_id', u.tenant_id, 'uom_name', u.uom_name, 'update_time', LEFT(DATE_FORMAT(u.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), 23),
                            'update_user', CAST(u.update_user AS CHAR)) AS row_j
                     FROM item_mji552rc_sub c JOIN unit_of_measurement u ON u.id = c.alt_uom_id AND u.is_deleted = 0
                    WHERE '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.needLines}}' = 'YES' AND c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.Item_id IN (SELECT CAST(a2.item_selection AS UNSIGNED) FROM sm_item_assembly_tlm8ve69_sub a2
                       WHERE a2.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND a2.sm_item_assembly_id = {{node:code_node_TRguard.data.ia}} AND a2.is_deleted = 0)
                    ORDER BY c.Item_id, c.id LIMIT 100000) x)) AS j

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT(
  'reqs', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(g.id AS CHAR), 'no', g.stock_movement_no, 'status', g.stock_movement_status, 'rev', g.source_ia_rev,
                  'fp', g.source_ia_fp, 'sl', (SELECT CAST(l.storage_location_id AS CHAR) FROM sm_location_transfer_d2c7o1jd_sub l
                   WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_location_transfer_id = g.id AND l.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY l.id LIMIT 1),
		'bin', (SELECT CAST(l.location_id AS CHAR) FROM sm_location_transfer_d2c7o1jd_sub l
                   WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_location_transfer_id = g.id AND l.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY l.id LIMIT 1),
                  'log', IF('{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.needDefect}}' = 'YES', g.request_log, NULL)))
             FROM sm_location_transfer g
            WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND g.is_deleted = 0 AND g.transfer_purpose = 'IA_SUPPLY' AND g.source_ia_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.ia}}'),
  'named', (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(g.id AS CHAR), 'no', g.stock_movement_no, 'status', g.stock_movement_status, 'purpose', g.transfer_purpose,
                   'source', g.source_ia_id, 'fp', g.source_ia_fp, 'rev', g.source_ia_rev, 'log', g.request_log, 'org', CAST(g.organization_id AS CHAR),
                   'sl', (SELECT CAST(l.storage_location_id AS CHAR) FROM sm_location_transfer_d2c7o1jd_sub l
                   WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_location_transfer_id = g.id AND l.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY l.id LIMIT 1),
		'bin', (SELECT CAST(l.location_id AS CHAR) FROM sm_location_transfer_d2c7o1jd_sub l
                   WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_location_transfer_id = g.id AND l.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY l.id LIMIT 1),
                   'lines', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(l.id AS CHAR), 'item_selection', l.item_selection, 'quantity_uom', CAST(l.quantity_uom AS CHAR),
                                    'requested_qty', l.requested_qty, 'source_ia_line_id', l.source_ia_line_id,
                                    'storage_location_id', CAST(l.storage_location_id AS CHAR), 'location_id', CAST(l.location_id AS CHAR)))
                               FROM sm_location_transfer_d2c7o1jd_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_location_transfer_id = g.id AND l.is_deleted = 0),
                   'openJobs', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gd_async_job j WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.is_deleted = 0 AND j.command = 'SAVE_LOT'
                                   AND j.correlation_id = 'LOT|{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.lot}}' AND j.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT',
		'COMMITTING_LOT', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW')),
                   'openTransit', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM in_transit_detail t WHERE t.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND t.doc_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.lot}}' AND t.is_deleted = 0
                                      AND t.status = 'In Transit'))
              FROM sm_location_transfer g WHERE '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.needNamed}}' = 'YES' AND g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND g.id = {{node:code_node_TRguard.data.lot}} AND g.is_deleted = 0)) AS j

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT(
  'sl', (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(s.id AS CHAR), 'plant', CAST(s.plant_id AS CHAR), 'active', s.storage_status, 'name', s.storage_location_name)
           FROM storage_location s WHERE '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.needDest}}' = 'YES' AND s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND s.id = {{node:code_node_TRguard.data.sl}} AND s.is_deleted = 0),
  'bin', (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(b.id AS CHAR), 'plant', CAST(b.plant_id AS CHAR), 'sl', CAST(b.storage_location_id AS CHAR), 'active', b.bin_status,
                  'name', b.bin_location_combine)
            FROM bin_location b WHERE '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.needDest}}' = 'YES' AND b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND b.id = {{node:code_node_TRguard.data.bin}} AND b.is_deleted = 0),
  'rule', (SELECT CAST(r.id AS CHAR) FROM su_code_serial_no_rule r
            WHERE '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.needDest}}' = 'YES' AND r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND r.business_type = 'Location Transfer' AND r.is_default = 1 AND r.is_draft = 0
              AND r.department_id = {{node:code_node_TRguard.data.org}} AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 1)) AS j

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT(
  'member', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blade_dept p
          WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND {{node:code_node_TRguard.data.org}} > 0 AND (p.id = {{node:code_node_TRguard.data.org}} OR FIND_IN_SET('{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.org}}',
		p.ancestors) > 0)
            AND FIND_IN_SET(CAST(p.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci,
                  (SELECT COALESCE(u.dept_id, '') FROM blade_user u WHERE u.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.id = {{node:code_node_TRguard.data.uid}} LIMIT 1)) > 0),
  'user', (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), NULLIF(u.name, ''), u.account) FROM blade_user u WHERE u.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.id = {{node:code_node_TRguard.data.uid}} LIMIT 1),
  'max', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(p.step_name, 7) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM gd_publish_step p
           WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = 'IATR|{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.ia}}' AND p.step_name LIKE 'CLAIM|%'),
  'now', DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),
  'setup', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('organization_id', s.organization_id, 'plant_id', CAST(s.plant_id AS CHAR), 'transfer_request_enabled', s.transfer_request_enabled,
                   'is_deleted', s.is_deleted))
              FROM item_assembly_setup s WHERE s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND s.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.org}}' AND s.is_deleted = 0)) AS j

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('lot', (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(g.id AS CHAR), 'no', g.stock_movement_no, 'status', g.stock_movement_status,
                 'fp', g.source_ia_fp, 'rev', g.source_ia_rev, 'purpose', g.transfer_purpose, 'source', g.source_ia_id, 'job', g.lot_v2_job_id,
                 'lines', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(l.id AS CHAR), 'source_ia_line_id', l.source_ia_line_id, 'requested_qty', l.requested_qty))
                             FROM sm_location_transfer_d2c7o1jd_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_location_transfer_id = g.id AND l.is_deleted = 0))
           FROM sm_location_transfer g
          WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.tenantId}}' AND g.is_deleted = 0 AND g.transfer_purpose = 'IA_SUPPLY' AND g.source_ia_id = '{{node:code_node_TRguard.data.ia}}' AND ({{node:code_node_TRguard.data.lot}} = 0 OR g.id = {{node:code_node_TRguard.data.lot}})
          ORDER BY g.id DESC LIMIT 1),
